title: WebMCP
description: Settings of the WebMCP tools that Jupyter exposes to browser agents.

tools.title: Additional tools
tools.description: Command-backed tools added to the default tools; a tool with the name of a default tool replaces it. Edit this list in the JSON settings editor.

disabledTools.title: Disabled tools
disabledTools.description: Names of the tools that are not registered (glob patterns with * and ?). Their commands can still run through execute_command.

blockedCommands.title: Blocked commands
blockedCommands.description: Ids of the commands that tools never run or list (glob patterns with * and ?). The defaults block the core commands that run a list of commands. For a strict setup, also block the menu commands that run other commands.

executionTimeout.title: Execution timeout (seconds)
executionTimeout.description: Tool calls still running after this time return a pending result and continue in the background. 0 waits forever; the maximum is 3600.

maxResultLength.title: Maximum result length
maxResultLength.description: Maximum length of a tool result, in characters of JSON (at least 1000). Longer results are shortened.
